selections.comment: ENROLLED can exploit a slight ease in grade to land the spoils and open his account on 8th attempt. Admirably consistent he's been beaten no more than three lengths in four handicap runs and under a length twice and should be suited to a return to 1m2f having gone well over it at Wolverhampton on penultimate start despite not being best placed for a sprint finish and turning very wide into the straight. If stamina wasn't the issue he'd be a danger to all but on balance is overlooked and Hot Dancer and The Hrse Horse can fill the frame in that order. Both have plenty of scope for improvement, arrive in decent nick and are entitled to bang there if finding extra for the step up in trip
